_comment: Default G2 suction head (since 2026-10-22, both arms; this pipeline uses the right arm): JODELL EVS08 vacuum gripper (EVS08 data sheet) with 4 custom 1.5-bellows cups (cup data sheet: 24 mm lip, 23 mm bellows, G1/8). Geometry from g2_pybullet_sim/build_evs08.py, measured on the robot where available (lfd-pick). Tool frame: origin at the centre of the cup square in the plane of the cup lips, axes = flange (arm_r_end_link) axes, +z = approach (into the part). Metres. Keys in _placeholders are not measured yet.
name: evs08
_comment_tool: flange -> uncompressed cup lip 128 mm (measured, lfd-pick learn.py TCP_OFFSET_M)
_comment_symmetry: symmetry_deg: the cup square (seal) repeats every 90 deg; the head does not (box body, side hardware), so grasps are sampled and collision-checked over 360 deg.
_comment_links: head_links: links rigidly fixed to the tool (after wrist joint 7), checked offline; the rest of the arm is checked by IK at execution time. gripper_r_empty_link = side hardware (vacuum generators, hand camera) as lfd-pick's measured capsule ring.
_comment_body: outline in the tool frame for the fast support-plane check at execution time: EVS08 body box (half sizes, z range) and the side-hardware ring as a cylinder (radius, z range; capsules r 65 mm at 90 mm, flange z -0.085..+0.105)
_comment_hold: vacuum 75 kPa (EVS08 maximum, 75%) and safety factor 1.5 g (chosen 2026-10-22); pull area = lip area
_placeholders: body mounting angle (115 mm side along flange x)
adapter disc between flange and body
side hardware is an envelope (capsule ring), not its real shape
